cliptude-cliptude-cliptude.description: Generate Cliptude videos from a saved template using the cliptude CLI or MCP. Use when the user wants a video from a topic, a custom script, an uploaded voiceover file, or a talking-head recording (same as create.html). If they asked only for a script or only for narration audio, use create_script / cliptude script or create_voiceover / cliptude voiceover instead of create_job. To turn that completed job into an MP4, use continue_job / cliptude continue (same job id). If they only gave a topic or title for a video, follow cliptude-script first — never pass the title as --prompt. If they have…

cliptude-cliptude-cliptude-plan.description: Plan every visual of a Cliptude video yourself — the look (theme, colours, style, music), every motion graphic and its text and timing, the search query, person or URL behind every shot, the transition on every cut, two-image reveals and every sound effect — and have Cliptude only voice, source and render it. Use for Faceless Documentary, Faceless Top 10, Avatar Video and Vector Explainer templates when the user wants the agent to direct the video (create_plan_job / cliptude plan-job), or asks to review or edit the plan before production.

cliptude-cliptude-cliptude-script.description: Research current facts with web search and write a Cliptude spoken narration (custom script). Use when creating a Cliptude video from a topic or title, or when the user has not pasted a full script and has not given a voiceover audio file or talking-head video. Skip this skill if they uploaded narration audio — use --voiceover / voiceover_path instead. Skip if they uploaded a presenter clip — use --talking-head / talking_head_path with a Talking Head template. Never pass the video title as the prompt.
